---
title: "About"
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['#quarto-sidebar a.sidebar-link.active[href="./about.html"][aria-current="page"]']
        - ['#quarto-sidebar a.sidebar-link:not(.active)[aria-current]']

The sidebar link to the current page is marked with `aria-current="page"`,
and no other sidebar link is. See quarto-cli#15190.
